parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the Cloud Firewall member accounts.

parameters.name: NetworkInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **cen_firewall**: CEN basic edition firewall

- **cen_tr_firewall**: CEN-TR firewall

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region ID. This parameter is required. If it is not specified, ErrorParameters is returned.

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The transit router instance ID. You must specify at least one of VpcId and TransitRouterId. Specify VpcId when querying a basic edition firewall, or specify TransitRouterId when querying a transit router (TR) scenario. If neither is specified, ErrorParameters is returned.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The VPC-connected instance ID. You must specify at least one of VpcId and TransitRouterId. Specify VpcId when querying a basic edition firewall, or specify TransitRouterId when querying a forward routing (TR) scenario. If neither is specified, ErrorParameters is returned.
